title_en: MASCON — GRAIL & THE LUMPY GRAVITY OF THE MOON
title_ru: МАСКОН — GRAIL И НЕРОВНАЯ ГРАВИТАЦИЯ ЛУНЫ
description: An interactive field guide to lunar gravity: Muller and Sjogren's 1968 discovery of mascons under the lunar seas, why low lunar orbits are unstable (PFS-2 fell after 35 days; frozen orbits at 27°, 50°, 76° and 86°), the GRAIL twins Ebb and Flow and their Ka-band ranging to 0.05 micrometres per second, gravity fields from degree 420 to 1800, and the thin, fractured crust they revealed.
og: Why did PFS-2 hit the Moon after 35 days? Integrate an orbit in the real GRAIL gravity field, feel a buried mascon from orbit, read the micron-per-second signal of Ebb and Flow and see how low you must fly to map a crater, checked against NASA, JPL and Science papers.
brand: MASCON — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
